body_text:
Axiom schema of replacement. Suppose a formula $\varphi(x,y)$ is
functional on a set $A$: for each $x\in A$ there is exactly one $y$
such that $\varphi(x,y)$. Then the range
$\{y:\exists x\in A\,\varphi(x,y)\}$ is a set. Replacement permits a
set-sized family of objects to be collected even when no common
ambient set for those objects was known in advance.
